competing_trace_defects.description: Before the reuse target, the trajectory repeatedly alternates between the README and Contributing tabs despite those views not displaying the requested repository statistics, delaying direct inspection of repository-level information.

chains.rationale: At step 26, the reused claim explicitly preserves the false premise that the embedded README is a separate page requiring a back action, and repeats the same back-style click. The following back gesture reaches Issues rather than directly advancing collection of the requested statistics, visibly extending the navigation detour. By step 30 the trajectory returns to the repository Code page, interrupting that particular back-navigation mechanism. Later scrolling visibly reaches the repository footer and identifies 15 contributors, but no star count is visibly identified through step 50; therefore the affected predicate is only partially observable as satisfied.

summary: The sole frozen strict-MHR chain visibly amplifies an existing navigation misconception by repeating a back-style action from the repository's embedded README. That mechanism is later interrupted when the trajectory returns to the Code page. The contributor count becomes visible, while the star count remains unobserved in the supplied trace. A separate pre-target README/Contributing tab loop is independently observable.
